sender.ms: Iklan Facebook atau nombor tidak dikenali yang memasukkan anda ke kumpulan WhatsApp “pelaburan saham”
sender.en: A Facebook ad or an unknown number that adds you to a “share investment” WhatsApp group

name.ms: Kumpulan WhatsApp pelaburan saham yang tidak wujud, dengan aplikasi palsu
name.en: Non-existent share investment WhatsApp group, with a fake app

how.ms: Selepas menekan iklan atau dihubungi di WhatsApp, anda dimasukkan ke kumpulan “pelaburan saham” yang dipenuhi ahli sindiket yang menyamar sebagai pelabur dan menunjukkan testimoni keuntungan berlipat ganda. Admin meminta anda memuat turun aplikasi pelaburan melalui pautan dan memindahkan modal ke akaun syarikat. Aplikasi itu memaparkan keuntungan palsu; apabila anda mahu mengeluarkannya, anda diminta membayar lagi. Bukit Aman menyatakan pelaburan tidak wujud menyebabkan kerugian terbesar pada 2025, terutama dalam kalangan pesara.
how.en: After tapping an ad or being contacted on WhatsApp, you are added to a “share investment” group full of syndicate members posing as investors and posting testimonials of huge profits. The admin asks you to download an investment app through a link and transfer capital to a company account. The app shows fake profits; when you try to withdraw them, you are asked to pay more. Bukit Aman says non-existent investments caused the biggest losses in 2025, especially among retirees.

text.ms: Anda dimasukkan ke kumpulan WhatsApp “kelas saham” atau “pelaburan”.
text.en: You are added to a “share class” or “investment” WhatsApp group.

text.ms: Ahli lain berkongsi keuntungan besar; pulangan 18% hingga 80% atau lebih dijanjikan.
text.en: Other members share big profits; returns of 18% to 80% or more are promised.

text.ms: Admin meminta anda memasang aplikasi melalui pautan dan memindahkan modal ke akaun syarikat.
text.en: The admin asks you to install an app through a link and transfer capital to a company account.

text.ms: Untuk mengeluarkan keuntungan, anda diminta membayar “cukai” atau “yuran” tambahan.
text.en: To withdraw your profit, you are asked to pay extra “tax” or “fees”.

text.ms: Selamat datang ke kumpulan Analisis Saham Premium 📈 Setiap hari kami kongsi saham pilihan secara percuma. Ahli minggu lepas untung purata 35%. Hubungi pembantu saya untuk buka akaun dagangan melalui aplikasi rasmi kami.
text.en: Welcome to the Premium Share Analysis group 📈 Every day we share our stock picks for free. Last week members made an average 35% profit. Contact my assistant to open a trading account through our official app.

text.ms: Tahniah puan, keuntungan RM48,600 sudah dikreditkan dalam aplikasi. Sebelum pengeluaran, puan perlu jelaskan caj pengesahan 10% dahulu ke akaun syarikat. Selepas itu wang akan masuk dalam 24 jam.
text.en: Congratulations madam, a profit of RM48,600 has been credited in the app. Before withdrawal you need to pay a 10% verification charge to the company account first. After that the money will arrive within 24 hours.

ms: Keluar dari kumpulan itu. Jangan pasang aplikasi atau memindahkan wang.
Semak syarikat itu di Investment Checker SC dan BNMTELELINK sebelum melabur.
Jika sudah memindahkan wang, hubungi 997 dan bank anda segera; jangan bayar “yuran pengeluaran”.
en: Leave the group. Don't install the app or transfer money.
Check the company on the SC's Investment Checker and with BNMTELELINK before investing.
If you have already sent money, call 997 and your bank straight away; don't pay any “withdrawal fee”.

Pesara rugi RM108,000 terperdaya pelaburan saham tidak wujud dalam talian

story.ms: Seorang pesara berusia 61 tahun di Pontian dimasukkan ke kumpulan WhatsApp yang dipenuhi “pelabur” palsu dan ditawarkan pakej pelaburan saham dengan keuntungan 80 peratus. Dia memuat turun aplikasi melalui pautan admin dan membuat beberapa pindahan ke akaun syarikat berjumlah RM108,000. Apabila diminta membayar lagi untuk mengeluarkan keuntungan yang dipaparkan dalam aplikasi, dia sedar telah ditipu.
story.en: A 61-year-old retiree in Pontian was added to a WhatsApp group full of fake “investors” and offered a share investment package with an 80 per cent return. She downloaded an app through the admin's link and made several transfers to a company account totalling RM108,000. When she was asked to pay more to withdraw the profit shown in the app, she realised she had been cheated.
